integrity: Exact integer and rational algebra plus independent finite enumeration reproduced by standalone checker; finite tests supplement rather than substitute for analytic universal arguments.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite iid replacement species sampling; minimal-support result restricted to two observations, with both-sign existence only at larger sampling depths. No field-data inference or sampling-without-replacement claim. Earlier Good (1953) source is known by month/year but a publicly verifiable exact first-public day was unavailable; 2012-12-01 is the precisely dated focal ecological source. Historical priority is provisional.
title: A sharp five-species sign boundary for singleton–missing-mass covariance
